prayers.title: Create in me a clean heart
I will both lay me down in peace
In the morning will I direct my prayer
Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
Why art thou cast down, O my soul?
Shew me thy ways, O LORD
Establish thou the work of our hands
Let the words of my mouth
Bless the LORD, O my soul
My help cometh from the LORD
Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak
Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth
The LORD is my light and my salvation
The LORD is my strength and my shield
My times are in thy hand
Cast thy burden upon the LORD
In the multitude of my thoughts
Riches and honour come of thee
Give me neither poverty nor riches
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee
Yet I will rejoice in the LORD
Not as I will, but as thou wilt
Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief
God be merciful to me a sinner
Come unto me, all ye that labour
Casting all your care upon him
If any of you lack wisdom
That ye might be filled with all the fulness of God
Filled with the knowledge of his will
The God of hope fill you with all joy and peace
The Lord of peace himself give you peace always
They that wait upon the LORD
Fear thou not; for I am with thee
The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart
Be still, and know that I am God
This is the day which the LORD hath made
Except the LORD build the house
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart
Commit thy works unto the LORD
Be strong and of a good courage
Let not your heart be troubled
God setteth the solitary in families
Be ye angry, and sin not
God shall wipe away all tears
A Collect for Peace
prayers.text: O God, who art the author of peace and lover of concord, in knowledge of whom standeth our eternal life, whose service is perfect freedom; Defend us thy humble servants in all assaults of our enemies; that we, surely trusting in thy defence, may not fear the power of any adversaries, through the might of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Morning Prayer, the second Collect, for Peace

prayers.title: A Collect for Grace (morning)
prayers.text: O Lord, our heavenly Father, Almighty and everlasting God, who hast safely brought us to the beginning of this day; Defend us in the same with thy mighty power; and grant that this day we fall into no sin, neither run into any kind of danger; but that all our doings may be ordered by thy governance, to do always that is righteous in thy sight; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Morning Prayer, the third Collect, for Grace

prayers.title: Lighten our darkness
prayers.text: Lighten our darkness, we beseech thee, O Lord; and by thy great mercy defend us from all perils and dangers of this night; for the love of thy only Son, our Saviour, Jesus Christ. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Evening Prayer, the third Collect, for Aid against all Perils

prayers.title: That peace which the world cannot give
prayers.text: O God, from whom all holy desires, all good counsels, and all just works do proceed; Give unto thy servants that peace which the world cannot give; that both our hearts may be set to obey thy commandments, and also that by thee, we, being defended from the fear of our enemies, may pass our time in rest and quietness; through the merits of Jesus Christ our Saviour. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Evening Prayer, the second Collect

prayers.title: A General Thanksgiving
prayers.text: Almighty God, Father of all mercies, we thine unworthy servants do give thee most humble and hearty thanks for all thy goodness and loving-kindness to us, and to all men. We bless thee for our creation, preservation, and all the blessings of this life; but above all, for thine inestimable love in the redemption of the world by our Lord Jesus Christ; for the means of grace, and for the hope of glory. And, we beseech thee, give us that due sense of all thy mercies, that our hearts may be unfeignedly thankful, and that we shew forth thy praise, not only with our lips, but in our lives; by giving up ourselves to thy service, and by walking before thee in holiness and righteousness all our days; through Jesus Christ our Lord, to whom with thee and the Holy Ghost be all honour and glory, world without end. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), A General Thanksgiving (the optional bracketed clause is left out)

prayers.title: Read, mark, learn, and inwardly digest
prayers.text: Blessed Lord, who hast caused all holy Scriptures to be written for our learning; Grant that we may in such wise hear them, read, mark, learn, and inwardly digest them, that by patience and comfort of thy holy Word, we may embrace, and ever hold fast, the blessed hope of everlasting life, which thou hast given us in our Saviour Jesus Christ. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Collect for the Second Sunday in Advent

prayers.title: The Collect for Purity
prayers.text: Almighty God, unto whom all hearts be open, all desires known, and from whom no secrets are hid; Cleanse the thoughts of our hearts by the inspiration of thy Holy Spirit, that we may perfectly love thee, and worthily magnify thy holy Name; through Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), The Communion, Collect for Purity

prayers.title: The protector of all that trust in thee
prayers.text: O God, the protector of all that trust in thee, without whom nothing is strong, nothing is holy; Increase and multiply upon us thy mercy; that, thou being our ruler and guide, we may so pass through things temporal, that we finally lose not the things eternal: Grant this, O heavenly Father, for Jesus Christ's sake our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Collect for the Fourth Sunday after Trinity

prayers.title: In all our works begun, continued, and ended
prayers.text: Prevent us O Lord, in all our doings with thy most gracious favour, and further us with thy continual help; that in all our works begun, continued, and ended in thee, we may glorify thy holy Name, and finally by thy mercy obtain everlasting life; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), The Communion, closing collects (“Prevent” here means “go before”)

prayers.title: Pardon and peace
prayers.text: Grant, we beseech thee, merciful Lord, to thy faithful people pardon and peace, that they may be cleansed from all their sins, and serve thee with a quiet mind; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Collect for the Twenty-first Sunday after Trinity

prayers.title: For Quiet Confidence
prayers.text: O God of peace, who hast taught us that in returning and rest we shall be saved, in quietness and in confidence shall be our strength; By the might of thy Spirit lift us, we pray thee, to thy presence, where we may be still and know that thou art God; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Family Prayer, For Quiet Confidence

prayers.title: Keep watch, dear Lord
prayers.text: Keep watch, dear Lord, with those who work, or watch, or weep this night, and give thine angels charge over those who sleep. Tend the sick, Lord Christ; give rest to the weary, bless the dying, soothe the suffering, pity the afflicted, shield the joyous; and all for thy love's sake. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1979, US), Evening Prayer: Rite One

prayers.title: For the Recovery of a Sick Person
prayers.text: O merciful God, giver of life and health; Bless, we pray thee, thy servant, N., and those who administer to him of thy healing gifts; that he may be restored to health of body and of mind; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Family Prayer, For the Recovery of a Sick Person (say the person's name at N.)

prayers.title: For Those We Love
prayers.text: Almighty God, we entrust all who are dear to us to thy never-failing care and love, for this life and the life to come; knowing that thou art doing for them better things than we can desire or pray for; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Family Prayer, For Those We Love

prayers.title: For all those who mourn
prayers.text: Almighty God, Father of mercies and giver of all comfort; Deal graciously, we pray thee, with all those who mourn, that, casting every care on thee, they may know the consolation of thy love; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), The Burial of the Dead

prayers.title: For Guidance
prayers.text: O God, by whom the meek are guided in judgment, and light riseth up in darkness for the godly; Grant us, in all our doubts and uncertainties, the grace to ask what thou wouldest have us to do, that the Spirit of Wisdom may save us from all false choices, and that in thy light we may see light, and in thy straight path may not stumble; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Family Prayer, For Guidance

prayers.title: For a Person under Affliction
prayers.text: O merciful God, and heavenly Father, who hast taught us in thy holy Word that thou dost not willingly afflict or grieve the children of men; Look with pity, we beseech thee, upon the sorrows of thy servant for whom our prayers are offered. Remember him, O Lord, in mercy; endue his soul with patience; comfort him with a sense of thy goodness; lift up thy countenance upon him, and give him peace; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Prayers and Thanksgivings, For a Person under Affliction

prayers.title: For Every Man in his Work
prayers.text: Almighty God, our heavenly Father, who declarest thy glory and showest forth thy handiwork in the heavens and in the earth; Deliver us, we beseech thee, in our several callings, from the service of mammon, that we may do the work which thou givest us to do, in truth, in beauty, and in righteousness, with singleness of heart as thy servants, and to the benefit of our fellow men; for the sake of him who came among us as one that serveth, thy Son, Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

source.name: Book of Common Prayer (1928, US), Prayers and Thanksgivings, For Every Man in his Work

prayers.title: Day by day (St. Richard of Chichester)
prayers.text:
Thanks be to thee, my Lord Jesus Christ,
for all the benefits thou hast given me,
for all the pains and insults thou hast borne for me.
O most merciful Redeemer, friend and brother,
may I know thee more clearly,
love thee more dearly,
and follow thee more nearly, day by day. Amen.

source.name: Prayer of St. Richard of Chichester (1197–1253), Devout.org prayer book

prayers.title: Let nothing disturb thee (St. Teresa of Avila)

source.name: Teresa of Avila, translated by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow; text as printed in Thomas Walsh, ed., Hispanic Anthology (1920)

prayers.title: Christ be with me (St. Patrick's Breastplate)
prayers.text:
Christ be with me, Christ within me,
Christ behind me, Christ before me,
Christ beside me, Christ to win me,
Christ to comfort and restore me.
Christ beneath me, Christ above me,
Christ in quiet, Christ in danger,
Christ in hearts of all that love me,
Christ in mouth of friend and stranger.

source.name: St. Patrick's Breastplate, translated by Cecil Frances Alexander (1889), public domain (Hymnary.org)

prayers.title: Make me an instrument of thy peace

source.name: The Peace Prayer, traditionally attributed to St. Francis. First printed in French in 1912 (La Clochette); first in English in 1927 (Friends' Intelligencer). This traditional English form as given by Marquette University

prayers.title: Our heart is restless (St. Augustine)
prayers.text: Thou awakest us to delight in Thy praise; for Thou madest us for Thyself, and our heart is restless, until it repose in Thee.

source.name: St. Augustine, Confessions, Book I, translated by E. B. Pusey (Project Gutenberg #3296)

prayers.title: When my mind won't settle
prayers.text: Lord, my thoughts are racing and my chest feels tight. You told me to be careful for nothing, so I bring You every worry by name. Here they are. I give them to You with thanks, because You already know each one. Guard my heart and mind with Your peace, the peace that does not have to make sense. Slow my breathing. Quiet my thoughts. Help me take the next small step, and trust You with the rest. Amen.

prayers.title: When I feel sad
prayers.text: Father, I am sad today, and I don't have to pretend with You. Your Word says You are near to the brokenhearted, so I believe You are near to me right now. Sit with me in this heaviness. Hold what I can't hold. Remind me that tears are not the end of my story, and that joy comes in the morning. Give me one reason to hope today, and the strength to hold on to it. Amen.

prayers.title: When I am grieving
prayers.text: Lord Jesus, You wept at Lazarus' grave, so You understand loss. My heart aches for the one I miss. Thank You for the love we shared and the memories I carry. Comfort me in the quiet moments when the missing hurts most. Surround me with people who care, and help me grieve with hope. I hold on to Your promise that one day You will wipe away every tear. Until then, carry me. Amen.

prayers.title: When I feel alone
prayers.text: God, I feel alone right now. But You promised, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee. Help me feel Your nearness in this room. Thank You that I am known and loved by You, even when no one else seems to notice. Open my eyes to the people You are placing in my life, and give me the courage to reach out. Set me in a family of faith where I belong. Amen.

prayers.title: When I am afraid
prayers.text: Lord, I'm afraid. You said, Fear thou not; for I am with thee. I hold on to that promise right now. You are bigger than what I'm facing, and You are not surprised by any of it. Strengthen me, help me, and hold me up with Your right hand. Give me courage for the next hour, and peace for tonight. I choose to trust You. Amen.

prayers.title: When I am angry
prayers.text: Father, I am angry, and You see why. Before I say or do something I'll regret, I bring it to You. Make me swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath. Show me what is true in this anger and what is pride. Cool my temper, guard my words, and give me wisdom for a calm reply. Where I have been wronged, I trust You to make it right. Amen.

prayers.title: Help me forgive
prayers.text: Lord, forgiving this person feels hard. They hurt me, and part of me wants to hold on to it. But You forgave me when I didn't deserve it. Make my heart tender again. I release this debt to You, and I ask You to bless them. Heal the hurt that's left in me, and show me wise boundaries where I need them. Let bitterness have no home in me. Amen.

prayers.title: When I am worn out
prayers.text: Jesus, I'm tired in my body and in my soul. You said, Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. So I come. I lay down what I've been carrying. Renew my strength like the eagle's. Help me rest without guilt, and show me what I can let go of. Restore my soul and give me the energy for what truly matters today. Amen.

prayers.title: When I want to give up
prayers.text: Lord, I'm discouraged. I've tried, and it feels like nothing is changing. Your Word says, let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not. Help me not to faint. Show me the progress I can't see, and remind me why I started. Give me grace for one more step today, and the faith to leave the harvest with You. Amen.

prayers.title: When I have done wrong
prayers.text: Father, I have sinned, and I own it. I'm sorry for what I did and for the hurt it caused. You promised that if I confess, You are faithful and just to forgive me and cleanse me. I receive Your forgiveness now. Lift the shame that wants to stay. Give me the humility to make things right where I can, and the strength to walk differently from here. Thank You for Your mercy. Amen.

prayers.title: A thank-you prayer
prayers.text: O Lord, thank You. You are good, and Your mercy endures forever. Thank You for life and breath, for food and shelter, for the people I love, and for every answered prayer I forgot to notice. Thank You for the hard things that taught me to trust You. Give me a grateful heart that sees Your hand everywhere today, and let my thanks spill over into kindness. Amen.

prayers.title: When my heart is full
prayers.text: Lord, my heart is happy today, and I want to celebrate with You. Every good gift comes from You. In Your presence is fulness of joy. Thank You for this moment. Help me enjoy it fully and share it freely. Keep me humble in good times, and let this joy become strength I can draw on when harder days come. Amen.

prayers.title: A prayer for peace
prayers.text: God of peace, You keep in perfect peace the mind that is stayed on You. Turn my thoughts toward You now. Quiet the noise around me and inside me. Bring peace to my home, my relationships, and my work. Where there is conflict, make me a peacemaker. Let Your peace rule in my heart today. Amen.

prayers.title: For strength today
prayers.text: Lord, today asks more of me than I feel I have. I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. Be my strength in every task and every hard conversation. When I feel weak, let Your power be made perfect in my weakness. Give me endurance, courage, and a steady heart, and let me finish today well. Amen.

prayers.title: For healing
prayers.text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed. You are the Great Physician, and nothing is too hard for You. I bring You my body and my pain. Bring healing, restore my strength, and give wisdom to the doctors and nurses who care for me. While I wait, give me peace and patience. I trust You with the outcome, and I thank You that You are with me in every moment. Amen.

prayers.title: For someone who is sick
prayers.text: Lord, I lift up the one I love who is sick. You see them right now. Touch their body with Your healing power. Ease their pain, calm their fears, and give them rest. Guide the hands and minds of everyone caring for them. Surround them with Your peace and with people who love them. Strengthen our faith while we wait on You. Amen.

prayers.title: When I need direction
prayers.text: Lord, I don't know which way to go. I choose to trust You with all my heart and not lean on my own understanding. Direct my path. Open the right doors and close the wrong ones. Give me clear thinking, wise counsel, and peace about the next step. If I need to wait, help me wait well. Amen.

prayers.title: For protection
prayers.text: Lord, be a shield around me and those I love. Give Your angels charge over us, to keep us in all our ways. Protect us at home, on the road, at school, and at work. Guard our minds from fear and our hearts from harm. Thank You that we are safe in Your care, wherever we go. Amen.

prayers.title: For my family
prayers.text: Father, I bring my family to You. Thank You for each one. Bless our home with love, patience, and laughter. Heal what is broken between us, and teach us to forgive quickly. Protect our children, strengthen our marriages, and comfort our elders. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD. Make our home a place where You are welcome. Amen.

prayers.title: When money is tight
prayers.text: Lord, You know what I need before I ask, and right now money is tight. You promised to supply all my need according to Your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Provide for the bills and the groceries. Give me wisdom with what I have, and creativity to find a way forward. Keep me from fear and from comparing. I trust You as my Provider. Amen.

prayers.title: A morning prayer
prayers.text: Good morning, Lord. This is the day which You have made; I will rejoice and be glad in it. I give You this day before it begins. Order my steps, guard my words, and help me notice the people You put in my path. Give me focus for my work and kindness for every conversation. Whatever today holds, You hold me. Amen.

prayers.title: A bedtime prayer
prayers.text: Lord, thank You for carrying me through today. Forgive me where I fell short, and help me let go of what I can't fix tonight. I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety. Quiet my mind, rest my body, and watch over everyone I love. Wake me refreshed and ready for tomorrow. Amen.

prayers.title: Before I study
prayers.text: Lord, I'm about to study, and I need Your help. You give wisdom liberally to anyone who asks, so I'm asking. Clear my mind of distractions. Help me understand what I read, remember what matters, and connect the ideas. Give me discipline to keep going when it gets hard. Let me study as unto You, faithful in small things. Amen.

prayers.title: On test day
prayers.text: Lord, today is test day. You have not given me a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. Calm my nerves. Bring back to my memory what I've studied. Help me read each question carefully, think clearly, and manage my time. Whatever the score, I know my worth is in You. I give You my best. Amen.

prayers.title: For focus
prayers.text: Lord, my attention keeps drifting. Help me set aside distractions and give my whole heart to this task, as unto You and not unto men. Quiet the notifications in my mind. Give me energy and steady focus for this next block of time. Let my work be excellent, and let it honor You. Amen.

prayers.title: While I wait for results
prayers.text: Lord, waiting is hard. I'm waiting for an answer and my mind keeps running ahead. Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart. Strengthen my heart while I wait. Whatever the result, You are still good and You still have a plan for me. Help me live fully today instead of worrying about tomorrow. Amen.

prayers.title: For my work
prayers.text: Lord, I bring You my work today. Let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us. Give me skill, integrity, and patience. Help me serve my coworkers and customers well. Where there is stress, give me peace. Where there is opportunity, give me courage. Let my work be a witness to You. Amen.

prayers.title: For my business
prayers.text: Lord, this business is a gift and a responsibility. I commit my work to You, and I ask You to establish my plans. Give me wisdom with every decision, honesty in every sale, and creativity to serve people well. Bring the right customers and the right partners. Guard me from shortcuts and from worry. Let this work provide for my family and bless others. Amen.

prayers.title: For wisdom in a decision
prayers.text: Lord, I have a decision to make, and I want to make it wisely. For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding. Help me see the facts clearly, count the cost, and listen to wise counsel. Show me what pleases You. If I'm rushing, slow me down. Give me peace when the choice is right. Amen.

prayers.title: For faithfulness with money
prayers.text: Lord, everything I have comes from You. Help me be faithful with what You've given me: to budget wisely, to pay what I owe, to save, and to give generously. Keep me honest in every number. Free me from the love of money and from fear of not having enough. Make me a faithful steward. Amen.
